title: Back with Dizzy's band; meeting John Lewis in the 92nd Division
summary: At rehearsal he found Moody and Gales in Dizzy's band; John Lewis phoned from Albuquerque, and Clarke explains they met in 1944 in remnants of the 92nd Division.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: So -- well, what happened then? So you got in touch with Dizzy.
Yeah. Well, I showed up at rehearsal, as I was telling you, when I came home, and at rehearsal I looked at the fellows in the band, and there sat James Moody and Joe Gales.
Yeah, Dizzy had contacted them some way or other.
And there he sat in the band. And I was so amazed. And you know how Moody...

So during this rehearsal -- well, we had several rehearsals, but during one of the rehearsals, I was just about to leave home, 'cause I lived up near City College, just a couple of doors from there, on Convent Avenue. So I get a telephone call just before I'm about to leave, you know, and it's John Lewis, who'd arrived from Albuquerque, and he said, "Listen, Kenny, I told you I would meet you in New York." I said, "Well, I'll be darned. What are you going to do?" He said, "Well, I'm supposed to go to Columbia," because he has a degree in anthropology from the University of New Mexico.
Et cetera, et cetera. And he was supposed to come to Columbia to study music, I suppose.

And I said, "Well --," I had told him while we were in the Army that I knew Dizzy Gillespie, so everyone laughed and said it was Army tales, and so forth. So I don't know whether he called me just to see if I knew Dizzy or whether he called me to let me know that he was here, and --
But you didn't tell me where you met John Lewis.
In the Army, here in France.
Well, he was in the -- this colored division, what was it -- 92nd Division.
And they came back to France, a great part of them, you know.
And I was assigned to their company, to that outfit -- division, rather.
And there I met John Lewis, who had formed a band and all that in the 92nd Division.
It was remnants of the 92nd Division.
So most of the guys were from Chicago, you know.
